purpose: Compact guide index thumbnail; article hero unchanged
prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: square index thumbnail for a China procurement guide. Generate a new 1024 by 1024 square image, an elegant photorealistic studio object illustration with one large, simple, centered subject occupying roughly 80 percent of the square. Plain light warm ivory seamless background, soft directional studio light and a short soft contact shadow. Restrained warm-neutral palette, tactile realistic materials, crisp broad silhouette recognizable when reduced to 80 pixels. Deliberately simpler than an editorial hero photograph. No people, hands, faces, room scene, background props, collage, split screen, frame, writing, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, screenshots, certificates or decorative graphics. Subject: one plain unbranded payment card resting beside and partly overlapping a single ivory invoice sheet. The card is warm dark bronze with softly rounded corners and only a small simple gold contact chip, no account numbers, logo, embossed writing, symbols or labels. The invoice is an unmarked white sheet with three simple broad pale-grey ruled lines, no readable or fake text. Close three-quarter overhead composition, the dark card is large and prominent with strong silhouette; objects form one compact still-life group. No money, lock icons, checkmarks, phones or screens.
alt: Generated illustration of a plain payment card beside a simple invoice sheet.
